Row.Text: Augments the in-game Victories screen. Under each victory card it adds a forecast strip naming which civ is projected to cross the threshold when the Point Goal next drops (Decisive 3x at 20% age progress, Momentous 2x at 40%, Substantive 1.5x at 60%, Narrow 1.25x at 80%), plus an ETA for the Scientific race to 100 Innovation. The tier ladder is read live from the game database, so rules mods and future patches are picked up automatically. No buttons and no user interaction — the screen simply gains extra rows.
